content: EMPIRICAL on pinned jellyfish 2.3.1 (Homebrew, this host): merge of two 240MB .jf files (2M-entry hashes, 24M distinct keys each) had peak RSS 6.8MB vs 212MB for count — merge is a streaming heap-based k-way merge, NOT an in-memory output-hash rebuild; output .jf file size is capacity-derived (240,000,834 bytes ~= input 240,000,890) not content-derived; merged stats: Total 48M = 24M+24M (additive), Distinct = union, Max_count sums
